title: RitualCore Altar Manual
summary: Build stable altar arrays, run diagnostics, and complete rituals without wasting catalysts.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: RitualCore owns the shared ritual gameplay slice. The first loop is a Basic Altar array with rune circles, offering pedestals, diagnostics, catalysts, and safe execution gates.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Build the altar array before spending rare ingredients. Empty-hand diagnostics should explain what is missing before any catalyst is consumed.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Prepare the array, place inputs, run diagnostics, ignite the ritual, read the result, and fix stability before attempting a riskier ritual.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: The Basic Altar, Offering Pedestal, Rune Circle, Stability Pylon, catalyst gates, structure validation, completion events, and failure events form the ritual safety layer.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: RelicTech stabilization, CurseCore cleansing, SpellCore awakening, HoloMap rift traces, Lens diagnostics, and MissionCore objectives all build on RitualCore events.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a ritual fails, trust the diagnostic first. Missing runes, wrong inputs, no active curse, or invalid relic state should fail before consuming catalysts.
